description: This Java source file defines the class ShipmentWorker which contains utility methods related to shipment processing, such as calculating package content value, splitting packages based on weight constraints, calculating package weight, and retrieving product information within the context of the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ShipmentWorker
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods for shipment calculations and operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getShipmentPackageContentValue
methods.description: Calculates the value of a shipment package content based on associated item issuances and order items, returning a BigDecimal representing the total value.

methods.name: getPackageSplit
methods.description: Splits shippable items into packages based on maximum weight constraints, returning a list of package maps with product quantities.

methods.name: calcPackageWeight
methods.description: Calculates the total weight of a package, converting units if necessary, and considering additional weight.

methods.name: getProductItemInfo
methods.description: Retrieves product information from a list given a product ID.
